MapObj/DL_HyFlagSquare/DL_HyFlagSquare.b.label: Hyrule Circuit's flag-square plaza prop
MapObj/DL_HyFlagSquare/DL_HyFlagSquare.b.note: A decorative foreground model native to Hyrule Circuit (the flag-lined plaza structure), occasionally reused by unrelated custom tracks as a ready-made building-block asset instead of modeling one from scratch. Omitting it just falls back to whichever copy the other checked mod provides (or the stock vanilla prop) at that spot - cosmetic only, never breaks the track.

MapObj/IronBall/IronBall.bfres.label: Waluigi Pinball's wrecking-ball obstacle
MapObj/IronBall/IronBall.bfres.note: The swinging wrecking-ball hazard native to DS Waluigi Pinball, sometimes reused by unrelated custom tracks that want a ready-made moving obstacle model. Choosing one mod's copy over the other only changes that object's look/texture where it appears - it's cosmetic, LayeredFS falls back to vanilla or the other mod's copy either way.

MapObj/Sanbo/Sanbo.bfres.label: Dry Dry Desert's pyramid/sphinx statue
MapObj/Sanbo/Sanbo.bfres.note: The large sphinx/pyramid statue prop native to GCN Dry Dry Desert, occasionally borrowed by unrelated custom tracks as an existing desert-ruins-style model rather than building a new one. Omitting it is cosmetic only - the spot just shows the vanilla or other mod's version of the statue, nothing functional breaks.

MapObj/VRCnsw17/VRCnsw17.bfres.label: GBA Sky Garden's skybox (Booster Course Pass)
MapObj/VRCnsw17/VRCnsw17.bfres.note: The background skybox model native to GBA Sky Garden (Booster Course Pass Wave 1). Skybox models are common building blocks that custom-track makers reuse wholesale on unrelated tracks needing a similar sky, then retexture them. Picking a side only changes the background scenery on that track - purely cosmetic, no gameplay impact.

MapObj/VRGcDesert/VRGcDesert.bfres.label: Dry Dry Desert's skybox
MapObj/VRGcDesert/VRGcDesert.bfres.note: The background skybox model native to GCN Dry Dry Desert, frequently reused by desert- or ruins-themed custom tracks as a base sky instead of building a new one. Omitting it just falls back to the stock desert sky or the other mod's repainted version in the background - cosmetic only.
